notes:
Passed on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device or hardware run). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is a model and reviewed_by is null. The fake backend is the package's own analytic kinematic stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream MuJoCo simulator and not a recording; it was never compared with the upstream environment because mujoco and gymnasium are not installed where the gate runs. What it does not cover, all stated in fidelity.gaps: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, task evaluator, randomizer or rewards; the 14D state is the last commanded action rather than projected qpos, so the gripper is not clipped and normalized to [0, 1] (abc_sim/env.py:31-47); reset options are ignored and the seed has no random draw (abc_sim/env.py:319-336); reset preserves the arm pose unless forget_arm_state() is called (abc_sim/env.py:304-315, :498-510); and the fake returns 3x4x4 placeholder images for the three camera names while the upstream default renders 3x480x640 per camera (abc_sim/env.py:87-88), so the real array size is 3x480x640 per camera and the camera set and size are configurable. The 14D action order and the Box(-1.0, 1.0, (14,)) action space match the clone (abc_sim/env.py:75-76, :175-179; action_space_ref). The declared sim backend is the upstream factory abc_sim:make_env (fidelity_by_backend sim = F1 mujoco:abc_sim); that route needs the upstream install (mujoco~=3.8.0 and gymnasium>=1.1, pyproject.toml:15 and :21) plus the simulator assets (abc_sim/README.md:181-185), was not run here, and requires deployment validation. No hardware backend, native.py, site-limits.example.json, ROS transport or hardware run is involved; a simulated R0 device has no operator-required limit. The warnings are the expected Gymnasium-family ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge sets the next reset seed without a native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived ticks, action.values and seed inputs; there is no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests and no extension ids. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review traced both ABC entry symbols, all citations, limits, synchronous stop behavior, provenance and Apache-2.0 license, and reproduced loss of non-JSON reset randomization metadata. Added sim.py to convert RandomizationState through its source-backed to_dict method and routed both backend factories through the adapter in driver.py and driver.lock.json; fake.py now supplies the native-shaped metadata fixture, honors image dimensions and accepts two-dimensional action chunks. Added regressions in test_driver.py and corrected citations and disclosures in facts.md. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; fake G1-G9 and strict collection pass. The upstream sim factory was inspected statically and never imported or run. For the human reviewer: The sim route still needs its runtime dependencies and downloaded assets, and the reset-info adapter was checked only on package fixtures. The R0 contract serves in-process MuJoCo and does not cover the separate i2rt hardware route under deploy/robot/followers/yam_follower.py. Real camera arrays and MuJoCo physics remain unvalidated.
